name: cot-peek
description: A floating ball that translates ZCode reasoning traces into Chinese in real time, plus on-the-fly clipboard translation.

description_i18n.en: A floating ball that translates ZCode reasoning traces into Chinese in real time, plus on-the-fly clipboard translation.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 思考小窗：悬浮球实时把 ZCode 的英文思维链翻成中文，半秒上屏，空闲零 CPU。附划词翻译，复制英文即出中文。
